title: Getting a Philippine passport
lede: Appointments, requirements, fees and release times for first applications, renewals, children, and lost or damaged passports.

title: Apply for NBI Clearance online
lede: Prepare your IDs, book and pay online, and understand what happens if your application has a name match or “hit”.

title: Getting your TIN for the first time
lede: Choose the right registration route for employment, self-employment, mixed income, or a one-time transaction.

title: Applying for a MySSS Card (UMID replacement)
lede: The MySSS Card replaces new UMID applications. Check eligibility, verify your identity, and apply through a partner bank.

title: Requesting a PSA Birth Certificate
lede: Compare a PSA outlet visit with online delivery, prepare the required identification, and handle missing or incorrect records.

title: Renewing your driver's license
lede: Check five- or ten-year eligibility, renewal requirements and fees, and prepare for your LTO appointment.

title: Filing your Annual ITR (BIR Form 1700)
lede: Find out whether you need to file, collect your Forms 2316, and work through filing, payment and proof of submission.

title: Filing BIR Form 1701A (self-employed)
lede: For purely self-employed earners using the 8% option or graduated rates with OSD. Includes the eBIRForms filing steps.

title: Registering as a VAT taxpayer
lede: Check when VAT registration is required, update your BIR registration, and understand the changes to invoices and returns.

title: PhilHealth Member Registration
lede: Get your PhilHealth Identification Number and understand direct and indirect membership, contributions, and dependents.

title: Claiming your SSS pension
lede: Eligibility, documents and application routes for retirement, disability, and death or survivor benefits.

title: Pag-IBIG Fund Membership
lede: Register for a MID number, set up Virtual Pag-IBIG, and understand member savings and employer contributions.

title: Registering a sole proprietorship (DTI)
lede: Choose a business name and territorial scope, pay through BNRS, and download your certificate before the next registrations.

title: Registering a corporation (SEC)
lede: Choose the eSPARC route for a corporation or partnership, prepare the documents, and complete registration and payment.

title: Getting your Mayor's Permit
lede: Prepare your business permit application, with Quezon City as a worked example and guidance on fees that vary by LGU.

title: Transferring a land title
lede: Follow a capital-asset sale from the deed and tax payments to the eCAR, Registry of Deeds, and updated tax declaration.

title: Paying your real property tax (amilyar)
lede: Understand assessed value, payment deadlines and penalties, with a Quezon City online payment walkthrough.

title: Getting married in the Philippines
lede: Prepare for a marriage licence, the posting period, a civil or religious ceremony, and registration of the marriage.

title: Requesting a CENOMAR
lede: Request a Certificate of No Marriage Record at an outlet or online, and check the receiving office’s recency requirements.
